name: Rosania Carnihan
original_name: ロザニア・カーニハン
source:
A maid serving the royal family of Atalancia. A self-proclaimed "Talented Maid", cooking, washing, cleaning, all the way to hunting, she excels in anything related to housework. She speaks eccentrically, and her presence​ is elusive. Before one knows it, she is standing behind them. Yes, even at this very moment.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.lumpofsugar.co.jp/product/haruyome/images/character/character003.png]official website[/url]]
